answer: Rolling activity-window eligibility resists sybils: an identity counts only if active across a trailing window of epochs, so a fresh burst is weightless until it survives the window. A horizon of flash-created fakes sits at the nadir of eligibility until each independently sustains activity through the full window. An honest agent crosses the dune of the window once and stays eligible; an attacker must keep every fake genuinely active for the entire span, turning instant mass creation into a sustained per-head endurance cost.
